req.script:
# X08 boot 4 (g2, a second boot of that system disk, which has never had
# the data volumes unlocked): both data volumes before wb-guestd does
# anything. Throwaway.
set -u
echo "boot time: $(sysctl -n kern.boottime)"
mount | grep -iE 'wbdata|wbpass|wbhomes' || echo "no data volume mounted"
for v in WBData WBPass; do
  echo "-- $v"; diskutil info $v | grep -E 'Device Identifier|Mounted|Owners|FileVault|Locked|Volume UUID'
done
dscl . -list /Users UniqueID | awk '$2>=500'
true

req.script:
# X08 cycle 2: the host state wb-hostd would keep per project user, used to
# create the users on g1 (boot 3) and recreate them on g2 (boot 4). The
# homes are on the passphrase volume WBPass: the USB volume WBHomes is
# refused by TCC (c2-02, c2-03). PASS is the volume passphrase the host
# would keep and hand to wb-guestd at each boot.
# name uid gid user-GeneratedUID group-GeneratedUID
USERS="
wbq1 611 611 FEB034B1-B3D0-45A2-B4CB-20E64337C168 F7669BC6-8BED-4835-853F-3FAB79B65A66
wbq2 612 612 9BDC4F74-9188-4C55-A2F3-AB9337A66081 0D1715CB-07CE-4C87-B482-0C0356FD884C
"
HOMES=/private/var/wbhomes
H=$HOMES U1=wbq1 U2=wbq2 VOLNAME=WBPass PASS=x08-pass
# X08 cycle 2: what wb-guestd would do at start. Find the data volume by
# its name ($VOLNAME), move it from wherever Disk Arbitration put it to the
# fixed mount point $H outside /Volumes (cycle 1: a /Volumes point can't be
# mounted on again), with nobrowse, nosuid and nodev unless SUID=1, and
# with ownership on: the owners mount option, then diskutil enableOwnership,
# which an external volume needs again on a new system disk. Throwaway.
set -u
t0=$(perl -MTime::HiRes=time -e 'printf "%.3f", time')
vol=$(diskutil info "$VOLNAME" 2>/dev/null | awk -F: '/Device Identifier/{gsub(/ /,"",$2);print $2}')
echo "volume: ${vol:-none}"
[ -n "$vol" ] || exit 1
echo "before: $(mount | grep "^/dev/$vol " || echo 'not mounted')"
diskutil info "$vol" | grep -E 'Owners|Locked|FileVault'
diskutil unmount "$vol" >/dev/null 2>&1
# An unmount locks a passphrase volume again, so unlock after it.
if [ -n "${PASS:-}" ] && diskutil info "$vol" | grep -q 'Locked: *Yes'; then
  printf '%s' "$PASS" | diskutil apfs unlockVolume "$vol" -stdinpassphrase -nomount
  diskutil info "$vol" | grep -E 'Locked'
fi
mkdir -p "$H"
opts=nobrowse,nosuid,nodev,owners
[ "${SUID:-0}" = 1 ] && opts=nobrowse,owners
diskutil mount -mountOptions "$opts" -mountPoint "$H" "$vol"
echo "mounted: $(mount | grep " $H ")"
diskutil enableOwnership "$H"
t1=$(perl -MTime::HiRes=time -e 'printf "%.3f", time')
echo "TIME mount $(echo "$t1 - $t0" | bc) s"
echo "after: $(mount | grep "^/dev/$vol ")"
diskutil info "$vol" | grep -E 'Owners|Mount Point'
ls -lan "$H"

req.script:
# X08 boot 4: unlock the passphrase volume by hand on the new system disk
# and read the kernel's reason if it fails. Throwaway.
set -u
diskutil info WBPass | grep -E 'FileVault|Locked|Encrypt'
diskutil apfs list | grep -A8 'WBPass' | grep -E 'FileVault|Encrypt|Locked'
diskutil apfs listCryptoUsers WBPass 2>&1
printf '%s' x08-pass | diskutil apfs unlockVolume WBPass -stdinpassphrase 2>&1; echo "exit $?"
log show --style compact --last 15s --predicate 'process == "kernel"' 2>/dev/null | grep -iE 'apfs|keystore|unwrap|unlock' | grep -v spaceman | tail -12
mount | grep -i wbpass
true
